messages.content: Explain what inflation means in economics. Answer in two to four sentences of plain prose.

message.content: Inflation is the general rise in the prices of goods and services across an economy over time. As these prices go up, the purchasing power of your money goes down, meaning a dollar buys less than it did in the past. While mild inflation is a normal sign of a growing economy, high inflation can make it difficult for people to afford everyday necessities.
